title: fix(sdk): keep the client flush within the page's keepalive budget

files.patch:
-export { ingestHeaders, SDK_HINT_HEADER, sdkHint } from "./platform/transport"
@@ -0,0 +49 @@
+	OTLP_KEEPALIVE_BYTES,
+	OTLP_UNLOAD_TAIL_BYTES,
@@ -0,0 +53 @@
+	SDK_HINT_HEADER,

- * request. It stops short of 64 KiB because the OTLP trace exporter spends
@@ -0,0 +86 @@
+ * events batch, a replay chunk, the Effect SDK's OTLP flush), so the budget
+ * has to be shared rather than checked per request. OTLP's own share is
+ * capped ({@link OTLP_KEEPALIVE_BYTES}), which keeps room for the session rows
@@ -0,0 +92 @@
+ * That is headroom, not a guarantee: the browser SDK's OpenTelemetry trace
-/** On `globalThis`: two bundled SDK copies still share one page-wide allowance. */
@@ -0,0 +102 @@
+/** The most of the budget that OTLP requests hold between them. */
+export const OTLP_KEEPALIVE_BYTES = 32 * 1024
@@ -0,0 +106 @@
+ * Largest body of newest items an OTLP flush sends first from a hidden or
+ * unloading document. Two signals' worth leaves about 4 KiB of OTLP's share
@@ -0,0 +110 @@
+export const OTLP_UNLOAD_TAIL_BYTES = 14 * 1024
@@ -0,0 +112 @@
+/** On `globalThis`: two bundled SDK copies still share one per-document allowance. */
@@ -0,0 +115 @@
+/** `otlpBytes` is absent on a holder created by an SDK copy that predates it. */
-	const existing = owner[KEEPALIVE_KEY] as { bytes: number } | undefined
@@ -0,0 +118 @@
+	const existing = owner[KEEPALIVE_KEY] as { bytes: number; otlpBytes?: number } | undefined
@@ -0,0 +125 @@
+/** Keepalive bytes an OTLP request could reserve right now: its own share and the total both apply. */
@@ -0,0 +130 @@
+		Math.min(OTLP_KEEPALIVE_BYTES - (inflight.otlpBytes ?? 0), KEEPALIVE_BUDGET_BYTES - inflight.bytes),
@@ -0,0 +137 @@
+ * marks an OTLP request, which also counts against {@link OTLP_KEEPALIVE_BYTES}.
-	if (inflight.bytes + bytes > KEEPALIVE_BUDGET_BYTES) return undefined
@@ -0,0 +142 @@
+	if (bytes > (otlp ? otlpKeepaliveRoom() : KEEPALIVE_BUDGET_BYTES - inflight.bytes)) return undefined
@@ -0,0 +186 @@
+		body.length > KEEPALIVE_BUDGET_BYTES

@@ -0,0 +27 @@
+ * with the final events flush, a replay chunk and the Effect SDK's OTLP
-		const body = init?.body && typeof init.body === "string" ? JSON.parse(init.body) : undefined

@@ -0,0 +5 @@
+// every POST reserves from the budget shared with the session writes, within
+// OTLP's share of it, and goes out as a plain request past that.
@@ -0,0 +12 @@
+	OTLP_UNLOAD_TAIL_BYTES,
@@ -0,0 +42 @@
+/** Abort a POST after this long, plus an allowance per KiB of body, so it cannot block the flush queue. */
+const POST_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000
+const POST_TIMEOUT_MS_PER_KIB = 10
-	/** Drain the buffers and POST them now (keepalive). Never rejects. */
@@ -0,0 +158 @@
+	/** Drain the buffers and POST them now (keepalive while the body fits the budget). Never rejects. */
-			method: "POST",
-			body: JSON.stringify(body),
-		if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`OTLP ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`)
@@ -0,0 +164 @@
+/** Keepalive-budgeted POST (see file header), aborted when it takes too long. */
@@ -0,0 +166 @@
+	const json = JSON.stringify(body)
+	const timeoutMs = POST_TIMEOUT_MS + (json.length / 1024) * POST_TIMEOUT_MS_PER_KIB
@@ -0,0 +170 @@
+		() => controller.abort(new Error(`OTLP POST timed out after ${Math.round(timeoutMs / 1000)}s`)),
@@ -0,0 +304 @@
+			if (res && !res.ok) throw new Error(`OTLP ${res.status}`)
@@ -0,0 +328 @@
+				tailBytes: unload && (() => Math.min(OTLP_UNLOAD_TAIL_BYTES, otlpKeepaliveRoom())),

@@ -0,0 +204 @@
+ * fit `maxBytes` (UTF-8) in one body, issued first so it gets the keepalive
@@ -0,0 +214 @@
+	const size = (chunk: ReadonlyArray<A>) => encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(body(chunk))).byteLength
